call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Wafer Supply Bottlenecks & TSMC Advanced Node Transitions
call_qa_forensic_highlights.hard_question: Andrew, with data center commitments jumping to 700 MW and Q4 revenue guided up to $320M, are you facing any allocation limits at TSMC for monolithic 5nm wafers, and when will Cerebras transition to 3nm/2nm for the next-generation CS-4/CS-5 accelerators?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.management_answer: Andrew Feldman (CEO): 'We have secured 100% of the TSMC wafer supply required to meet both our Q4 guide and our plan to triple revenue in 2027. Because we use monolithic wafer-scale silicon rather than advanced CoWoS packaging or HBM memory stacks, we completely bypass the industry's biggest supply chain choke points. CS-4 tape-out is on schedule, and we see zero silicon gating for our delivery roadmap.'
call_qa_forensic_highlights.forensic_verdict: STRONG REASSURANCE: Direct confirmation that bypassing CoWoS packaging gives Cerebras a structural lead times advantage over Nvidia and AMD.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: GAAP vs Core Revenue Divergence & Customer Warrant Amortization
call_qa_forensic_highlights.hard_question: Bob, GAAP revenue missed consensus at $210.8M while Core revenue beat at $230.9M. Can you walk through the $20M delta and specifically how customer warrant amortization will impact reported GAAP margins over the next four quarters?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.management_answer: Bob Komin (CFO): 'The $20.1M variance is entirely non-cash amortization associated with strategic customer equity warrants granted at the time of multi-gigawatt contracted capacity signings. As cloud inference volumes ramp and hardware deliveries accelerate in Q4, that non-cash discount diminishes as a percentage of top-line, which is why our Core gross margin expands directly to 47%-49% next quarter.'
call_qa_forensic_highlights.forensic_verdict: ACCOUNTING CLARITY: Demonstrates that the GAAP revenue optical 'miss' was purely non-cash warrant timing, while underlying cash collections and Core revenues surged.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: CapEx Surge & Free Cash Flow Burn Runway
call_qa_forensic_highlights.hard_question: You spent $497M on CapEx in Q3 and burned $871M in True Free Cash Flow. At what point does data center build-out peak, and when do customer cash deposits turn operating cash flow sustainably positive?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.management_answer: Bob Komin (CFO): 'CapEx in Q2 and Q3 represented front-loaded capital deployment to secure 700 MW of high-density powered shell capacity across North America and Europe. With Q4 operating margins reaching breakeven (-1% to +1%), operating cash flow inflects sharply in the first half of 2027 as customer deposits on our $25.4B backlog convert.'
